# Joey Wilkes — Imperial 2.0

This static portfolio presents source-backed work across data science, AI,
engineering, analysis, and research.

## Public pages

- `/` — interactive evidence ledger, experience, writing index, recommendations
- `/projects/` — four project records with archived sources
- `/writing/` — three sample article outlines
- `/about/` — professional focus and working principles
- `/contact/` — public profile channels
- `/profile.json` — machine-readable profile and project index

## Content status

Project records are derived from linked archived reports. Experience is a
source-backed public profile record. Writing entries are labeled sample
article outlines.
